sampling_design: three independent invocations; three blocks per invocation; ten measurements per block/config/rank; five warmups per invocation/config
rank_aggregation: rank-local mean/std/CV; max of rank means is a conservative training critical-path proxy
primary_estimator: arithmetic mean latency per rank; no median substitution; future A/B comparison must use identical paired block IDs
outlier_policy: classify slow valid samples and retain them; statistical outlier tests never delete a sample
invalid_sample_policy: explicit independent thermal/power/hardware fault with provenance
uncertainty_method: future paired block bootstrap, deterministic seed 1515, 10000 resamples; current baseline reports raw distribution only

stability_qualification.rationale: backward local microbenchmarks are exposed to per-device clock and unrelated-process jitter; this threshold is fixed for the backward era and is not tuned from any candidate score

environment_note: GPU0 had elevated temperature/clock variability and GPU1 had an unrelated CUDA process during collection; this is retained as provenance, not corrected by changing clocks or killing processes
